reviews.title: Critical Data Loss + No Support Response
reviews.text:
I experienced a complete loss of all calendar events after updating the email associated with my account due to a security issue.

• All past, current, and future events were deleted
• Data is missing both in the app and on the Jorte web platform
• Tasks remained, which suggests a system-level issue—not user error

There was no warning that changing the linked email could result in permanent data loss.

This included time-sensitive medical appointments and health-related tracking, creating a real risk due to loss of critical scheduling data. 

I contacted support multiple times with a detailed, urgent request and received no response or acknowledgment.

A calendar app that can lose all event data during a basic account change—with no warning, no recovery, and no support—is not reliable.

Until this is addressed, I cannot recommend using this app for anything important.
